title: 공증사무 이의신청사건의 처리에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Method of Filing Objection)
(1) A person who intends to file an objection pursuant to Article 81 (1) of the Notary Public Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") shall submit a written objection to the chief prosecutor of the district prosecutors' office having jurisdiction over the notary public subject to the objection (hereinafter referred to as the "notary public concerned").
(2) The written objection under paragraph (1) shall state the purport and grounds of the objection and may be accompanied by other necessary materials.
